The ~2000 MPa figure is a group-level prediction.
assumption: Both alloys are solution-treated and peak-aged, with no retained austenite or overaging. The rec-0008 claim (>=2000 MPa) applies directly only to c000. c101 lacks Co, Mo and Ti, so it likely falls short, and the group prediction is an upper-end estimate for it.
